Retracted the accounting scenario-maintenance basis for certification. Both accounting Playwright specs were restored byte-for-byte to baseline, and the unchanged locked suite then passed all 9 steps at 100/85. The earlier selector repair is not part of the candidate or its valid proof claim.

Bound current-revision deployed proof to an explicit Convex URL and deployed function specification, added a non-secret server launch-posture receipt, and required exact frontend/backend/deployment identity plus strict auth, enforced credits, bounded grants, and unpaused controls before the authenticated browser journey can pass. Focused verifier, auth, mobile, and posture tests passed 45/45; no deployment or production mutation executed.

The full pre-ship gate passed with zero production dependency vulnerabilities, source/dist security, design, QA, content, freshness, fresh-room, SLO, both typechecks, 310/310 Vitest files (2,117 tests), 29/29 product-memory browser cases, and production builds. The independent launch-surface suite passed 19/19, NodeAgent and Omnigent adapter smokes passed, and the unchanged accounting certification suite passed all 9 steps at 100/85. Deployment-bound authenticated proof remains missing and no deployment or production mutation executed.

The first clean-commit CI-bundle attempt failed before command execution because Node on Windows cannot launch npm.cmd without the command shell. Added an explicit platform invocation contract and a real child-process regression probe; the repaired floor passes both typechecks and 310/310 files with 2,118 tests. The failed bundle is ignored local output and is not valid evidence.
